messages:
Riley (Events): Heads up — stream goes live in 18 minutes. small change: we're moving roadmap to after Q&A because of time. Can AV confirm recording + captions?
Omar (Eng): Seeing OBS CPU spike on the encoder laptop during test stream, might drop frames if we keep high-res. Can we reduce to 720p fallback?
Derek (Audio): On it. Also stage mic 2 is crackling on warmup. I'll swap to lav in 2 mins.
Riley (Events): @Derek thanks. If mic swap takes longer we should call a 2-min buffer before starting.
Ashley (Marketing): Recording failed on the last rehearsal, the local recorder crashed. If cloud capture is flaky we can do a backup local on my Mac — but need RTMP creds.
recording-bot: Automated check: ingest endpoint healthy. RTMP auth token expires in 25m. Link: https://recording.internal/runs/198765
Omar (Eng): Network ACL on the conference VLAN blocked NDI earlier. @Nina can we open 10.0.3.0/24 -> encoder host for RTMP/NDI temporarily?
Nina (Ops): I'm on it. Patching ACL now, will confirm in 30s. Also increasing QoS for the encoder host.
Priya (Product): FYI leadership — moving roadmap is fine. If we shorten demos, can leadership confirm they want Q&A first or a condensed roadmap then Q&A?
Jules (CEO): Let's do a condensed roadmap (10 mins), then Q&A. Qs that need tech detail can be tagged and we'll follow up in breakouts.
Derek (Audio): Lav swapped, testing mic 2 — levels good, no crackle now. :thumbsup:
Omar (Eng): Reduced output to 720p and changed keyframe to 2s. CPU now stable in tests.
Ashley (Marketing): Got RTMP creds, starting local capture as backup. Will upload raw file to the drive after show.
Riley (Events): Great. Final check: captions provider reported 20–30s latency. We'll put a note in chat to expect delayed captions and add live transcript link.
Priya (Product): For follow-ups: 1) confirm recording upload within 1h 2) collect demo artifacts for the condensed roadmap 3) compile unanswered Qs for the leadership follow-up thread.
Jules (CEO): Perfect. Thanks team — if anything blocks start, @Riley call the show. Otherwise let's start on time and keep flexibility in the runbook.
Riley (Events): Thanks everyone — recording + fallback in place, mic fixed, network patched. Starting warm count at T-5.
